system.description:
“Flow like water, strike like the tide.” You embody the adaptable current and the unstoppable wave. You command the battlefield with fluid movements and crushing force, striking foes from afar with liquid reach and shaping the very water around you to both shield and devastate.

LEVEL 3

Shape Water (1).

Requires: a source of water in Reach. 1+ Actions, Reach: 2. Describe your Small or Tiny water/ice effect to the GM, or choose one from the list below. The longer or more powerful the effect, the more Actions it costs. Effects must be utilitarian and cannot replace attacks or tiered abilities.

  • Control liquid (not inside a creature), changing its temperature, reshaping it, etc.
  • Pull water from a plant.
  • Create a cloud.
  • Remove water from mud to create dirt.
  • Wash dirt & stains from an object.

Novice Tidal Warrior.

You can swim as fast as you can walk, can hold your breath twice as long, and your unarmed strikes can deal Cold damage. You no longer learn any Martial Arts Abilities. You learn all Novice (Sho) Water Forms. When you roll initiative, you gain +1 Burst of Speed.

LEVEL 7

Shape Water (2).

You can now manipulate up to a Medium amount of water.

Intermediate Tidal Warrior.

Your unarmed strikes become Reach 2. You learn all Intermediate (Ga) Water Forms. Your forms grow stronger. When you roll initiative, you gain +1 Burst of Speed (total 2).

LEVEL 11

Shape Water (3).

You can now manipulate up to a Large amount of water.

Advanced Tidal Warrior.

(1/round) While in at least a Large body of water, you can use a BoS maneuver for free. You learn all Advanced (De) Water Forms. Your forms grow stronger.

LEVEL 15

Shape Water (4).

You can now manipulate up to a Huge amount of water.

Expert Tidal Warrior.

While in at least a Large body of water, your unarmed attacks have Reach 4. You learn all Expert (Yoi) Water Forms. Your forms grow stronger. When you roll initiative, you gain +1 Burst of Speed (total 3).

Water Forms

Water Forms are special techniques that replace Martial Arts Abilities. They follow the same rules for Spells and other effects and use your Hero DC when needed. There are 4 ranks of forms: Novice (Sho), Intermediate (Ga), Advanced (De) and Expert (Yoi) and cost 0, 1, 2, or 3 Bursts of Speed to activate respectively. Each form gains additional bonuses as Tidal Warrior increases. Forms can deal Bludgeoning, Cold, Piercing or Slashing damage (whichever feels most appropriate). All forms require a source of water, though water can take many forms.

Novice (Sho) Forms

  • Flowing Strike (Sho Form) — 1 Action. Reach: 4, Damage: 1d4+KEY. On hit: push Medium or smaller targets 1 space away or apply Slowed, 1 turn. High Levels: die step increases every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: is considered a melee attack for Reverberating Strikes.
  • Redirect Flow (Sho Form) — 1 Action. Reach: 4, Reaction: When attacked. Defend for free, the incoming attack has disadvantage. If the attack misses and your target is in Reach, knock them Prone. High Levels: +5 Armor every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: deal LVL damage when a target is knocked Prone.
  • Ocean’s Wall (Sho Form) — 1 Action. Wall: 4. Create a wall of water/ice. The wall lasts 1 round. Each panel has KEY HP. High Levels: Wall +2 every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: the wall no longer has to be straight but each panel must be contiguous with the last.
  • Sea Glide (Sho Form) — 1 Action. Move: Up to 4 spaces, ignoring Slowed Terrain and bodies of water. Until the end of your next turn, you can “walk” on water. High Levels: +2 speed every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: enemies adjacent to your move are Slowed, 1 turn.

Intermediate (Ga) Forms

  • Tidal Slam (Ga Form) — 2 Actions. Line: 4 or Burst: 4, Damage: 4d8. On hit: targets entirely in the area are knocked Prone. High Levels: +6 damage and Line +2 / Blast +1 every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: targets knocked Prone are Dazed.
  • Creeping Ice (Ga Form) — 2 Actions. Arc: 4, Damage: 4d8 and targets are Restrained by ice (KEY HP) on a failed DEX save. Half damage on save and targets aren’t Restrained. High Levels: +6 damage and Arc +2 every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: the area remains Slowed Terrain for 24 hours.
  • Misted Veil (Ga Form) — 2 Actions. Burst: 1, Concentration: Up to 1 minute. Mist fills the area providing Cover and obscuring vision. You can shape the mist inside for free effecting spaces of your choice. High Levels: Burst +1 every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: enemies inside no longer have Cover.
  • Sacred Water (Ga Form) — 2 Actions. Reach: 4, Restore: 2d8 HP. High Levels: +4 HP restored every Tidal Warrior. Expert Tidal Warrior: remove 1 negative condition.

Advanced (De) Forms

  • Water Cloak (De Form) — 1 Action. Concentration: Up to 1 minute. Your arms are wrapped in water. Your unarmed strikes become Reach 4 and deal an extra 1d6 damage. On hit: you can grapple a Large or smaller target. Expert Tidal Warrior: Reach +2 and you gain 2 additional “arms” for grappling.
  • Cascading Columns (De Form) — 2 Actions. Line: 8 or Arc: 6, Damage: 4d8+6. Medium and smaller targets are launched 8 spaces in the air and fall on a failed DEX save. On a save they are not launched. Expert Tidal Warrior: +6 damage and the columns remain in place for 1 minute. Each column takes up 1 space, is 8 spaces high, and has LVL HP. Effected allies take no damage, automatically pass their save and can remain on/besides the columns.
  • Ocean’s Current (De Form) — 1 Action. Concentration: Up to 1 minute. You gain a fly speed of 8, though your maximum height is 8 spaces. Medium or smaller enemies you fly over are pushed 1 space out of the way and Slowed, 1 turn. Enemies can be affected by this 1/turn. Expert Tidal Warrior: all non-AoE forms become Reach 8 for the duration.
  • Surf (De Form) — 2 Actions. Blast: 4, Damage: 4d8+6. Ignores armor. On a failed STR save, Large and smaller enemies are pushed out of the area and knocked Prone. Expert Tidal Warrior: +6 damage, Blast +2 and you can choose to ride the wave to anywhere in the area.

Expert (Yoi) Forms

  • Pinwheel (Yoi Form) — 2 Actions. Burst: 2, Concentration: Up to 1 minute. A high speed ring circles the outer edge of the area. Enemies that pass through the edge take 4d8+12 damage. Large and smaller enemies that pass through the ring must make a STR save or be pushed to the furthest opposite edge outside the area. Ranged attacks targeting those inside are completely obstructed if they originate from outside the area.
  • Pressure Shot (Yoi Form) — 2 Actions. Line: 8, Damage: 1d4+35 Force. Ignores armor. On a max die roll, deal +35 damage. On a die roll of 1, it only deals 20 damage.
  • Ocean’s Prison (Yoi Form) — 2 Actions. Reach: 4, Blast: 2, Concentration: Up to 1 minute. Damage: 4d8+12 on a failed DEX save and targets are Frozen. Half damage on a success and targets aren’t Frozen. Allies in the area can choose to fail and become Frozen for 1 turn instead of the entire duration and regain HP equal to half the damage dealt instead.
  • Water Compression (Yoi Form) — 1 Action. You compress a source of water into a highly dense bead that hovers around you. For 24 hours, you do not need a water source and melee attacks against you have disadvantage. During this time, you gain 1 BoS at the start of your turns while in initiative. Once you use this form, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before doing so again.
